name: PTC
description: PTC sells software that manufacturers use to design products (CAD: Creo and Onshape) and to manage a product through its life (PLM: Windchill, Codebeamer, Arena; service tools ServiceMax and Servigistics). About 95% of revenue is recurring subscription or support, billed on multi-year, non-cancellable contracts, so reported revenue can swing with the timing of on-premises contract starts. It reports one segment. In March 2026 it sold its Kepware and ThingWorx industrial-IoT businesses to a TPG-affiliated buyer and used the proceeds partly for an accelerated buyback.

businessLines.name: PLM software
businessLines.how: Multi-year subscription contracts (on-premises subscription, SaaS and support) for product-lifecycle, application-lifecycle and service software; revenue for on-premises subscriptions is recognised largely up front when the contract term starts.

businessLines.name: CAD software
businessLines.how: Per-seat subscriptions for 3D design software (Creo on-premises, Onshape cloud-native SaaS), mostly multi-year; growth driven by contract value and duration.

businessLines.name: Professional services
businessLines.how: Implementation and consulting fees; shrinking on purpose as PTC leaves delivery to partners.

brands.name: Creo, Windchill, Codebeamer, ServiceMax, Servigistics, Arena, Onshape
brands.note: Product brands; revenue is reported only as PLM ($1,639.0M, 59.8%) and CAD ($992.9M, 36.2%), not per brand.

brands.name: Kepware and ThingWorx (sold)
brands.note: Sold 2026-03-13 to Parrot US Buyer, L.P. (TPG Global affiliate) for $530.8M plus up to $125M contingent; gain $462.6M.

whatsNext.text: New $2 billion buyback authorisation starts (runs to 2028-09-30).
Transition services agreement to the Kepware/ThingWorx buyer runs up to 12 months from the sale.
